description: Move the file explorer to the right within Files and preview Markdown by default.

userStories.title: Place the explorer to the right
userStories.description: As a user, I want the file explorer to the right of the file editor so that the editor sits next to chat.
acceptanceCriteria: On desktop, the file editor appears to the left of the explorer within `FileEditorPanel`.
On desktop, the resize handle stays between the editor and the explorer, and collapsing the explorer leaves the editor visible.
On mobile, selecting a file still hides the explorer and shows the editor; the explorer toggle still restores the tree.
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill.
userStories.notes: Desktop order and resize handle: executed npm test -- src/tests/components/FileEditorPanel.layout.test.tsx src/tests/components/FileEditorPanel.manual-save.test.tsx (exit 0); browser screenshot .claude/screenshots/explorer-right-us001.png shows editor, handle, explorer in order. Collapse: executed agent-browser click Collapse sidebar; snapshot retained File editor and Show file explorer. Mobile: focused mock test passes; browser mobile check remains for final integrated acceptance. Browser: executed agent-browser at localhost:5173 on authenticated thread (exit 0).

userStories.title: Preview Markdown when a file opens
userStories.description: As a user, I want Markdown files to open in preview so that I can read formatted content first.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a `.md` file renders `MarkdownCard` before the user presses the preview button.
The preview button changes the selected `.md` file to code, then changes it back to preview.
Selecting another `.md` file starts in preview, including after the user viewed code in an earlier file.
`.html`, `.htm`, and `.mmd` files still open in code; non-previewable files still open in the editor.
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill.
